name: 学習結果に合う本の提案
prompt:
Create a faithful Japanese recommended-book card on a 390 × 290 px white canvas. Use the native preview for exact content, typography, positions and card border. Use the source screenshot only for original book/content context. Reference 3 is the exact book cover; place it unchanged at its native position and size. Return the component canvas only, without phone frame, extra page chrome or decoration.

The user dislikes tint colors. Keep the canvas, card interior and all other surfaces pure white #FFFFFF. No cream, mint, blush or pale gray fills; no gradient, glow, shadow, colored wash or texture. Use a thin solid forest-green #047857 card outline and two flat solid forest-green buttons with white labels. Use near-black #1D1D1D text, neutral-gray #6E6E6E metadata, and preserve the exact colors inside the supplied book-cover artwork.

Match this 390×290 layout:
- White card x=16/y=8, 358×272, 4 px corners, 1 px forest-green outline.
- Heading x=32/y=22, 326×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28, exact text “次の一歩のために学ぶ”.
- Supporting line x=32/y=60, 326×16, Meiryo Regular 12/16, exact text “この結果に合わせた学びのヒント”.
- Exact supplied book cover x=32/y=92, 66×101; do not redraw, crop, recolor or overlay it.
- Book title x=116/y=94, 242×24, Meiryo Regular 14/24, “お金との付き合い方を学ぶ”.
- Author x=116/y=128, 242×16, Meiryo Regular 12/16, neutral gray, “ラミット・セティ”.
- Metadata x=116/y=162, 242×16, Meiryo Regular 12/16, neutral gray, “15分　・　8つの学び”.
- “聞く” button x=32/y=208, 152×52, radius 10, flat forest green #047857 with centered white Meiryo Regular 14/24 text.
- “読む” button x=202/y=208, 152×52, same solid green and white text.

Keep all text exact, maintain the book-cover proportions and compact spacing, and keep every surface white. Add no icons or other content beyond what is present in the native preview.
reviewNotes: Pure-white UI surfaces confirmed; exact book-cover media and slight card/top-text alignment remain unresolved after first render.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
